environment.hardware: Training and frozen evaluation used NVIDIA H200 143771 MiB, driver 580.173.02. JAX GPU preallocation was disabled because an unrelated process was active. Aggregation and tests used CPU.

mathematics.assertion_tested: Starting from each seed-35--39 source actor-critic and Adam state, compare 32-update PPO branches at the inherited and quarter learning rates under overwrite probabilities 0.05 and 0.30. At each probability, subtract the standard-rate final exact deterministic-mode return from the quarter-rate return within seed, then report all paired differences, their mean, normal-task retention, risk exposure, actor movement, sampled-policy performance, and adaptation loss.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Integer episode, transition, trigger, event, and loss counts; path returns and probability weights use IEEE-754 binary64 with discount 0.995. An independent Decimal recomputation used precision 50.
mathematics.conventions: Each condition is an equal-weight mean over five learner seeds. Each seed exact-mode value is an equal-weight mean over 32 natural validation starts. For fixed-kernel path i with success s_i, length T_i, and risky-harvest count k_i, success is s_i(1-p)^k_i and discounted return is s_i*0.995^(T_i-1)*(1-p)^k_i. Existing fixed-kernel failure is distinct from overwrite loss. Paired signs use tolerance 1e-12.
inputs: Twenty completed cell summaries, 640 ordered update records, 80 retained checkpoint receipts and state files, and 80 preregistered evaluations under the canonical RAID run root.
non_claims: The quarter learning rate is not claimed optimal.
Learning rate is not identified as the sole cause of the prior rare-defect degradation.
A lower source-panel KL is not a guarantee of task preservation or a measurement of off-anchor behavior.
The p=0.05 versus p=0.30 difference is not attributed to experience frequency alone.
Five learner seeds do not establish statistical significance or generalization beyond these policies, starts, budgets, and defect model.

randomness.generator: JAX PRNG with learner seeds 35--39. Within seed, all four branches shared initial actor-critic, Adam state, worker state, action/environment/sampler RNG states, and a slot-indexed fold_in-derived defect-uniform stream. Overwrite probability was only the threshold and was not observed.

checks: All 20 preregistered jobs completed exactly 32 updates and 1,048,576 collector slots; the aggregate is 20,971,520 slots with 20,480 optimizer applications, zero empty minibatches, zero teacher updates, and zero BC updates.

All 640 update records were present and ordered. Retained checkpoints were exactly updates 0, 2, 8, and 32 for each job; all 80 state files matched their receipts and all rolling resume directories were empty.

The run-manifest job matrix, execution-source set, source-checkpoint file set, source hashes, prescribed source paths, source global updates, update-zero train-state hashes, and non-intervention checkpoint configuration all matched the frozen manifest.

Within seed, all four origins had identical restored train-state and fresh-worker hashes. Every update-zero actor had zero argmax changes on its frozen source anchor, same-p exact results matched, and all four fixed-mode risk profiles matched.

All execution sources and three pinned prerequisites retained their launch hashes. No failed-job marker remained. RAID ended with 7,860,743,675,904 free bytes, above the declared peak-plus-reserve requirement.

The focused overwrite suite passed 28 tests with one warning. The full repository passed 510 tests and had nine pre-existing provenance-sensitive failures: eight Mine execution or manifest hash checks and one historical spatial GPU source hash check.

An independent precision-50 Decimal recomputation read all 20 final episode panels directly. Maximum success error was 1e-16, maximum per-panel return error was 1.421875e-16, and maximum aggregate return error was 2.0175625e-16.

The compact result names mean 1-(1-p)^k as overwrite-incident probability, including normally failing paths, and separately reports normal success minus exact success as overwrite-attributable success decrement.

At p=0.05, quarter-minus-standard exact-return differences were negative, negative, positive, positive, negative for seeds 35--39; their mean was 0.03340664942112133. At p=0.30 the signs were negative, negative, negative, negative, tie; their mean was -0.036213029222091374.
The compact result was mechanically compared with the canonical raw result for all four final aggregates, all 20 seed rows, all 16 curve points, and all ten paired return differences.
result: At p=0.05, the quarter-rate branch preserved all 160 paths on the finite deterministic normal-kernel panel and its source mean normal return, reduced risky starts from 94/160 to 86/160, and reached exact target return 0.8845607435934053. This was 0.0022728906539563496 above source and 0.03340664942112133 above the standard-rate branch on average. However, the paired advantage occurred in only two of five seeds; the mean was driven by preventing standard-rate normal-panel failures in seeds 37 and 38. At p=0.30, the quarter rate preserved the finite normal panel but left 72/160 risky starts versus 44/160 at the standard rate and reduced target return by 0.036213029222091374, with four negative seeds and one tie. The intervention substantially reduced source-panel KL and argmax changes at both probabilities. Under this fixed 32-update budget, the result supports a preservation-versus-adaptation tradeoff, not a generally superior learning rate or an asymptotic speed claim.
residual_risks: The training runner, environment, exact-path evaluator, and aggregation code are internally authored. Hashes, paired initialization checks, checkpoint receipts, independent Decimal arithmetic, and focused tests reduce but do not eliminate common-implementation error.

The exact computation assumes independent Bernoulli fires and the verified physical invariant that any first grain loss makes the three-grain target unreachable. It is exact only for deterministic argmax on the finite validation panel.
The source-visitation KL anchor does not cover states visited only after the policy changes.
The positive p=0.05 mean is heterogeneous: two large positive seed differences outweigh three small negative differences.

The full repository was not globally green because nine historical provenance-sensitive tests failed. Their failure does not invalidate the scoped gates, but it also does not revalidate those historical experiments against current sources.
